LightningComponentBundle.description: A configurable list view for any Salesforce object. Set the object and columns in Experience Builder.

property.name: objectApiName
property.label: Object API Name
property.description: API name of the object to display (e.g., Order, Account, Invoice__c)

property.name: fieldApiNames
property.label: Columns (API Names)
property.description: Comma-separated field API names, including relationship paths (e.g., Account.Name)

property.name: linkField
property.label: Link Column (API Name)
property.description: Field rendered as a clickable link. Defaults to the first column.

property.name: recordUrlPattern
property.label: Record URL Pattern
property.description: Use {recordId} as placeholder. Example for Orders: /s/order?recordId={recordId}

property.name: searchField
property.label: Search By Field (API Name)
property.description: Comma-separated fields to search against on the list page

property.name: sortConfig
property.label: Default Sort
property.description: Field and direction, e.g. Name ASC or CreatedDate DESC

property.name: filterClause
property.label: Filter Logic (WHERE clause)
property.description: SOQL filter without WHERE keyword, e.g. Status = 'Draft'

property.name: recordLimit
property.label: Row Limit
property.description: Leave blank to show all records on list pages with infinite scroll.

property.name: viewAllUrl
property.label: View All URL
property.description: Link shown on summary views when row limit is set

property.name: listPagePath
property.label: List Page Path Suffix
property.description: URL path suffix that enables search and infinite scroll (e.g., order-list)
